about_the_game:
Immerse yourself further through the lore of Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny with the Official soundtrack and its official artbook.

  • The first part contains The Art of Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny, featuring over 110 pages of behind-the-scenes stories, in-game, and concept art.

Art booksize PDF format

  • The second part contains 31 Tunes Official Soundtrack Composed by EXP Studio.
